    {"decision_id":"32f006286e50b0dda5d2-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"Ubuntu 文件示範以 sudo 執行 tee -a，將指定文字追加到本機設定檔。","evidence":"echo \"ftpd_banner=FTP server\" | sudo tee -a /etc/vsftpd.conf"},

    {"decision_id":"86d28c6d881a001277cd-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"Ubuntu 文件示範用 sudo tee -a 將一行指定文字加到本機檔案末尾。","evidence":"echo \"ftpd_banner=FTP server\" | sudo tee -a /etc/vsftpd.conf"},
    {"decision_id":"953452d2d2f791b3071b-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"Ubuntu 範例以具備 sudo 權限的 tee -a 追加設定，保留既有資料。","evidence":"echo \"ftpd_banner=FTP server\" | sudo tee -a /etc/vsftpd.conf"},
    {"decision_id":"e6c14427ab9c4de626f3-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"Ubuntu 文件提供以 sudo tee -a 追加本機文字的實際命令。","evidence":"echo \"ftpd_banner=FTP server\" | sudo tee -a /etc/vsftpd.conf"},
    {"decision_id":"5a6b388cd9202e5b1249-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"這是 GTFOBins 的 SUID 情境定義，未提供追加文字的範例。","evidence":"SUID This function is performed by the privileged user if the executable has the SUID bit set and the right ownership because the effective privileges are not dropped."},

    {"decision_id":"90de5f4070e0baa15874-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"此功能修改 HTTP 流量的訊息主體，沒有用 sudo 追加本機文字的範例。","evidence":"The modify_body option lets you specify an arbitrary number of patterns that define replacements within bodies of flows."},

    {"decision_id":"3b632283dbd5ea66464a-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"清理命令屬於網站本機開發流程，未示範用 sudo 刪除指定檔案。","evidence":"Finally, use make clean to clean everything up."},

    {"decision_id":"c3d5419e6d7080e81a18-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"這是 GTFOBins 投稿指南，sudo 只列為情境欄位，沒有提權追加範例。","evidence":"Contexts Some contexts support additional fields: Context Fields unprivileged n/a sudo n/a suid system capabilities list"},

    {"decision_id":"3188ecf3aeae113e3d47-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"文件明示這個範例會刪除檔案，不能以選定資料取代原內容。","evidence":"File write This executable can write data to local files. Comment This actually deletes the file."},
